sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement (updated October 15, 2025)
sources.supports: Section 1: Special Links must use the special 'tagged' link formats Amazon provides. Section 5: required on-site statement 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.'

sources.title: Associates Help — Why do I have to identify myself as an Associate? (disclosure requirements)
sources.supports: Link-level disclosure must be legally compliant (FTC), and the Operating Agreement statement must clearly and conspicuously appear on the site.

sources.title: Understanding ASINs: Your guide to Amazon's product identification system
sources.supports: ASIN = Amazon Standard Identification Number, a unique 10-character alphanumeric code; typically starts 'B0'; appears after /dp/ in the product detail page URL.

sources.title: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
sources.supports: Material connections must be disclosed; disclosures must be hard to miss, placed with the endorsement, in plain language ('advertisement', 'ad', 'sponsored').

sources.title: Advertisement Endorsements — Endorsement Guides topic hub
sources.supports: Endorsements must be truthful and not misleading; compensated promoters must disclose (Endorsement Guides, revised June 2023).
